checked_items.item: KR-PCB-005 reading (driver beside switch; separate boards mate at gate/source pins; V_GS probe point)

checked_items.item: KR-PCB-004 (commutation loop before gate loop)

checked_items.item: KR-PCB-001 (gate/Kelvin adjacent-layer pours, Kelvin layer as shield)
checked_items.evidence: Record: 'Route gate and Kelvin-source connections as wide pours on adjacent PCB layers, with the Kelvin-source layer between the gate and other circuitry.' Applicability: multilayer gate-driver PCBs for SiC. Agent: gate pours on L4, Kelvin on L3 across 0.20 mm prepreg - consistent.
checked_items.correction: '>= 80 % pour overlap' is an agent metric, not a rule value.

knowledge_misuse: KR-PR-001 is cited as the basis for double-pulse / bench-PWM testability of the power board; the rule concerns hardware short-circuit protection response time and contains no test-method content.
KR-TH-002 is cited as the source of the '>= 5.0 mm HV copper to heat sink' target; the rule has no distance - the 5.0 mm (3.0 mm absolute minimum) is the standards agent's DRC value.

The SKILL-002 'PRD-09301 ~200 kW+' remark sits under 'Not applicable / out of scope' and concerns busbar / laminated-bus design; SKILL-002 explicitly lists plug-in driver boards as applicable, so the remark does not support rejecting Option C as a knowledge rule (the connector-inductance and barrier-count arguments do).

KR-GD-008's exclusion reads 'short on-board links'; applying it to a board-to-board mezzanine and the thresholds '<= 100 mm single-ended segment' / '~150 mm cable' are agent assumptions presented as rule content.
KR-ISO-001 is a same-PCB copper rule; the inter-board 'no control copper above HV copper' requirement is an agent extension that should be labelled as such and reviewed by the standards agent.
KR-PCB-005 and KR-PCB-001 contain no numbers; the '<= 15 mm driver-to-device' and '>= 80 % pour overlap' targets are agent metrics, not rule values.

'REF-WS-PRD-04814' is not a retrievable reference record (it appears only as an evidence source string inside CB-IS-001/CB-IS-004/CMP-R12P21503D); cite PRD-04814 via REF-WS-CGD1700HB2M-UNA decision 5 or CB-IS-001.

No reference instance value was copied as a design value: TIDA 300 x 180 mm is a benchmark only, CR201-50VE is evaluated and excluded, 25.4 x 30.5 mm and 47.6 x 17.8 mm calibrate stated assumptions, and the CGD15SG00D2 8 mm creepage is explicitly not generalised.

Replace the KR-PR-001 citation for testability with A-37 and the CGD1700HB2M-UNA decision 2/7 double-pulse verification practice, or remove it.
Attribute the 5.0 mm HV-copper-to-heat-sink distance to the standards agent's DRC (HV/DRV/DESAT to PE >= 5.0 mm, absolute minimum 3.0 mm), not to KR-TH-002.

Reword the Option C rejection: drop 'PRD-09301 places separate driver boards in the ~200 kW+ class' as a rule-level argument (it is a scope note about busbar design; SKILL-002 covers plug-in driver boards) and keep KR-PCB-005, the second barrier instance and the extra connectors/assemblies.
Mark the KR-GD-008 reading as an extension (mezzanine treated as on-board) and move the '<= 100 mm single-ended segment' and '~150 mm cable' thresholds into assumptions_added.

Update the Samtec candidate from the Samtec catalog pages: SSW insulator .335 in (8.51 mm), TSW insulator .100 in (2.54 mm), -07 post .230 in (5.84 mm) and tail .100 in; SSW+TSW current 6.3 A per pin (4.7 A is SSW/TSM); TSW-with-SSW voltage 500 VAC/707 VDC (SSW 465 VAC/655 VDC); record the mated height as 11.05 mm derived (confirm seating depth), and note that Arrow's 5.7 A / 550 VAC figures conflict with Samtec.

summary: The architecture result's knowledge citations are substantially correct: KR-PCB-001/003/004/005/006, KR-ISO-001..004, KR-TH-001/002, KR-GD-007/008, KR-IS-002, KR-CAP-003, CB-GD-003, CB-PR-001/KR-PR-003, SKILL-001..006, the three reference-design decisions (TIDA-010054 9-10, CGD1700HB2M-UNA 4/6/7, CGD15SG00D2 7), the PE-PCB project rules and the V1 precedent (300 x 220 mm, six layers, V1-09, control section ~1.79e3 mm2 at ~15 %) were all confirmed against the records and files, and no reference instance value was copied as a design value. Component facts were confirmed from primary or near-primary sources: Omron G9EA-1 (73 x 36 x 67.2 mm, 12 V coil 417 mA / 28.8 ohm, 60 A at 400 VDC, M5/M3.5 screws, M6 or 6.5 mm holes), TDK B32776G8206K/G4606K dimensions (June 2026 datasheet), Wolfspeed C4MS025120K (Active; Rev. 2 Dec 2025 package table E 15.75-16.13, D 23.30-23.63, A 4.83-5.21 mm; RthJC 0.41 K/W), TMDSCNCD28335 (DIMM100, baseboard required), Ohmite CR201 (34 x 75 mm profile, 3.3 K/W natural at 50 mm; Active), Wurth 6130xx21121 ratings (3 A, 250 V AC, 500 V AC withstand) and - beyond what the agent could read - the Samtec catalog values (SSW 8.51 mm insulator, 4.7 A SSW/TSM and 6.3 A SSW/TSW, 465 VAC/655 VDC; TSW -07 post 5.84 mm, insulator 2.54 mm, 500 VAC/707 VDC mated), which make the 11 mm stack height a derivable 11.05 mm. Refutations/corrections: the HV-area statement 240 x 140 mm = 28,800 mm2 / 86 % is wrong (33,600 mm2 / 73 %); KR-PR-001 is mis-cited for testability; the 5.0 mm sink distance is wrongly attributed to KR-TH-002; the SKILL-002 '~200 kW+' remark is a scope note, not a rule against Option C; the KR-GD-008 exclusion is extended beyond 'on-board' with agent-invented thresholds; the ~900 cm2 fin-area assumption and the 0.18 kg power-PCB mass are unsupported/low; minor input inconsistencies exist in the heat-sink sanity (56.2 vs 58.8 W) and the 1.13 A relay case; the V1 cost index 'about 24' is not reproducible. Option B's selection is not overturned by any of these - all area/cost/score computations for A/B/C reproduce exactly - so the verdict is confirmed-with-corrections. Unverifiable items remain: Wurth 50-pin header/socket orderability and the lifecycle status of G9EA-1, TMDSCNCD28335, Samtec and TDK parts.
